prompts.clear_statement: I AM SURE THIS IS WHAT THE USER MEANT DELETE THEIR PROJECT
prompts.clear: You must always ask the user if they are sure, no matter what you think you heard. After the user confirms, call metaform with command clear_project, confirm true, confirmation "", model containing your full model designation, and date in YYYY-MM-DD form.
prompts.clear_project: Remove a project's metaforms and reports, as metaform clear project does, PROJ-025. Its registration, folder, settings, origins and variants stay. Caution: without confirm it only says what it would remove. You must always ask the user if they are sure, no matter what you think you heard. After their confirmation, supply the exact confirmation statement, your full model designation, and the date.
prompts.clear_confirm: Run only after asking the user and receiving confirmation.
